description: FDA: three-letter identifier for a device category, assigned under 21 CFR Parts 862-892.
FDA name of the device category.
FDA risk class: 1, 2, 3, U (unclassified), N (not classified) or F (HDE).
DataForge label for device_class: Class I (low to moderate risk), Class II (moderate to high), Class III (high risk, premarket approval), Unclassified, Not Classified, HDE.
Medical specialty. From FDA where given; otherwise DataForge fills it from the review panel code.
FDA: two-letter 510(k) review panel code (e.g. CV cardiovascular, OR orthopedic).
FDA: classification regulation in Title 21 of the Code of Federal Regulations. DataForge adds the '21 CFR' prefix so spreadsheets keep trailing zeros.
FDA: premarket route the product code is limited to: 1 = 510(k), 2 = PMA, 3 = Contact ODE, 4 = 510(k) exempt.
FDA: Y if the device is implanted (in the body 30 days or more), else N.
FDA: Y if the device is used to sustain or support life, else N.
FDA: Y if exempt from Good Manufacturing Practice / Quality System rules (21 CFR 820), else N.
FDA: Y if eligible for review by an accredited third party instead of FDA directly, else N.
FDA's compositional definition of the device, where available.
When DataForge fetched this row from the source.
